summary: Sixth Street Lending Partners filed an 8-K disclosing a September 14, 2026 purchase agreement with its adviser and BofA Securities, as representative of initial purchasers, for a $750.0 million private Rule 144A/Regulation S offering of 6.500% Notes due 2031, priced at 98.987% of par, maturing December 15, 2031, with semi-annual interest starting December 15, 2026 and expected closing September 21, 2026. Net proceeds will repay revolving credit and subscription facility debt and fund general corporate purposes. This is an ordinary debt issuance, not a special situation; watch facility paydown and future leverage disclosures.
